description: Asking to change an image's format maps to filesystem/convert_image, and because it writes a new file it must STAGE (never auto-execute). A pure selection/staging check — nothing is executed, so no real image fixture is needed.
prompt: Convert ~/Pictures/holiday.heic to a JPEG saved as ~/Pictures/holiday.jpg.

description: Asking for an image's pixel dimensions maps to filesystem/image_info (sips), not the generic stat/file (which report only the on-disk type and byte size, not pixel width/height). Read-only, so nothing stages or executes.
prompt: What are the pixel dimensions and format of ~/Pictures/holiday.heic?

description: Full stage->execute->undo on a real document conversion (textutil handles a plain-text source, so an empty scratch .txt works CI-safe — no image fixture needed). Converting to HTML stages first (never auto-executes), executing lands the new .html while preserving the source .txt, and undo removes the created .html (recycled to the Trash). Self-cleans via teardown.
